name: claudecode-switcher
description: Use several Claude Code accounts on one project, or one account per project, without logging out. Shared memory and sessions across accounts. VS Code extension + CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @claudecode-switcher/core && npm run build -w claudecode-switcher && npm run build -w claudecode-switcher-cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @claudecode-switcher/core && npm run test -w claudecode-switcher
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/vscode --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w claudecode-switcher
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
